extracted.intended_audience: photojournalists, visual journalists, journalism students, and members of the NPPA
extracted.subtask_description: Guiding principles and standards for visual journalists on accurate, respectful, and responsible photographic and video reporting. Emphasizes truthfulness, context, nondiscrimination, and limits on intrusion or manipulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the NPPA Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of the NPPA Code of Ethics is to promote the highest quality in all forms of visual journalism and strengthen public confidence in the profession.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as an educational tool both for those who practice and for those who appreciate photojournalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Journalist Role
rubrics_metrics.description: Their primary role is to report significant events to the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes obligation to inform the public through visual reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Journalist Goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Faithful and comprehensive depiction of the subject at hand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists should aim to represent subjects accurately and completely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility to document society
rubrics_metrics.description: A visual journalist has responsibility to do what? Document society and to preserve its history through images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Photography and video serve as historical record and public documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of photographic and video images
rubrics_metrics.description: Images can reveal great truths, expose wrongdoing and neglect, inspire hope and understanding and connect people around the globe through language of visual understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes the constructive societal effects images can have and the ethical weight of that power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential for harm from images
rubrics_metrics.description: What is true about photographs? Photographs can do great harm if they are callously intrusive or manipulated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a caution to avoid intrusion and manipulation because of possible harm to subjects and public trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy and comprehensiveness when representing subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: When representing subjects visual journalists should be what? Visual journalists should be accurate and comprehensive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accuracy and completeness should govern selection, framing, captioning, and editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide context
rubrics_metrics.description: Photojournalists should be: Complete and provide context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid presenting images in a way that misleads by omission; captions and presentation should supply necessary context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid stereotyping
rubrics_metrics.description: Photojournalist should avoid doing this: Stereotyping individuals or groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be attentive to portrayals that reinforce harmful or simplistic generalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capture just the facts in an unbiased manner
rubrics_metrics.description: Photojournalist should strive to do this: Capture the just the facts in an unbiased manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain impartiality in composition, selection, and narrative conveyed by images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat subjects with respect, dignity and compassion
rubrics_metrics.description: Photojournalist should treat all subjects in what manner? Treat all subjects with respect, dignity and compassion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respectful treatment applies regardless of subject's status or situation; consider effects on vulnerable people.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit intrusion on private moments of grief
rubrics_metrics.description: Intrude on private moments of grief only when the public has an overriding and justifiable need to see.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weigh public interest against individual privacy and dignity before photographing victims of crime or tragedy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not alter or influence events
rubrics_metrics.description: When photographing subjects do not do any of the following: Intentionally contribute to, alter or seek to alter or influence events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid staging, interfering, or otherwise changing events to manufacture a more dramatic image.
